description: Complete brand colour system in one call. Returns colour roles with archive names, light and dark mode role maps, typography guidance, usage rules per colour, design tokens (CSS, Tailwind, Figma), and citation cards. Deterministic. No LLM cost. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.
